newsitem.title: UK: Graystone bid approach talks terminated.
newsitem.headline: Graystone bid approach talks terminated.

text.p: British engineering and components distribution group Graystone Plc said on Friday that talks about a possible offer for the company have been terminated.
Graystone had announced on July 16 that it had received a possible bid that could lead to an offer at a significant premium to the current market value.
The company said today that talks about the sale of the company's engineering companies are continuing.
Graystone also warned that it expects pre-tax profits for the year to June 30, 1998 to be "materially" below current market expectations.
By 1152 GMT, shares in the company had fallen 39-1/2p to stand at 42p.
